channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] USF's Williams II earns Lee Roy Selmon Award
item.description: USF defensive end Mike Williams was named the second-ever recipient of the Lee Roy Selmon Award, honoring integrity and leadership on and off the field.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Former Nashville hospital social worker charged with rape, sexual battery
item.description: TBI agents say a former Centennial Medical Center social worker sexually assaulted two patients. Investigators believe there may be additional victims.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New York schools to ban AI for all students not yet in high school
item.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Wednesday schools will discontinue AI programs for students below the 8th grade.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] At least 1 killed and 6 injured in shooting in downtown Minneapolis
item.description: At least one person was killed and six others injured Wednesday in a shooting at an apartment building in downtown Minneapolis, according to officials.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa federal agents seize 22,000 ancient artifacts in one of agency’s largest busts
item.description: Federal agents in Tampa have seized more than 22,000 artifacts from Europe, Africa and the Mediterranean as part of an ongoing investigation into international antiquities smuggling, officials announced.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Grassroots groups push for public power ballot measure on 2028 ballot to replace Duke Energy in St. Petersburg
item.description: A coalition of grassroots organizations announced the Public Power campaign Wednesday with the goal of letting voters decide whether to create a city-owned electric utility.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Petersburg police chief defends Flock cameras amid FDOT mandate to remove them on state roads
item.description: St. Petersburg Police Chief Anthony Holloway is defending automated license plate readers following a state mandate that will require the removal of the technology on state roads.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Jury recommends death, life without parole for Billy Adams in murder of mother and unborn child
item.description: A jury recommended the death penalty for Billy Adams on one murder count and life without parole on another after he was convicted in the deaths of Alana Sims and her unborn child.

item.description: The data cloud needs a place to land. Florida's candidates for governor disagree on the welcome mat.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Netflix set to air a documentary regarding the president's secret flight switch
item.description: Netflix is turning a real-life presidential security operation that took place this year into a documentary.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] AI carts may be boosting spending for consumers according to a new study
item.description: Artificial intelligence is already helping people decide what to buy and even what to eat, but is it really making life easier or just helping retailers sell more?

item.description: Danielle Grant pleaded not guilty in the hit-and-run death of 82-year-old Francisco Lugo near Bruce B Downs in New Tampa.

item.description: On Wednesday, Hillsborough County commissioners unanimously approved a new ordinance that those residents helped push for, but many of them say the fight is not over.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Private-sector hiring hit the brakes in August with just 38,000 jobs added
item.description: Private-sector hiring hit the brakes in August. According to the latest ADP report, businesses added just 38,000 jobs.

item.description: Largo woman returns home after hurricane recovery program funds rebuild. Pinellas Recovers has approved 1,000+ applications, investing about $90 million in the community since October 2025.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FDA approves drug providing hope for pancreatic cancer patients
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved a new drug offering hope for people with pancreatic cancer, which is one of the deadliest types of cancer.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Crew from USS Abraham Lincoln takes a break in Thailand after long months at sea
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has docked in Thailand after nearly nine months at sea supporting U.S. operations against Iran.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Southwest Airlines unveils plans for its first-ever airport lounges
item.description: Southwest Airlines has unveiled plans for its first-ever airport lounges. The airline is partnering with Chase to bring flyers a new experience before heading on one of their flights.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: Mummified cheetahs found in caves are rewriting history
item.description: Seven naturally mummified cheetahs discovered in caves near Arar, Saudi Arabia, have yielded the first DNA ever extracted from a mummified large feline — and the results surprised even the lead researchers.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] You can buy $1 coins with Trump's face and a gold finish from the US Mint
item.description: The U.S. Mint will start selling a $1 coin to celebrate America's 250th birthday, featuring President Donald Trump's face on one side.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Manifest Prosthetics blends craftsmanship and technology to help restore independence
item.description: The veteran-owned business combines hands-on craftsmanship with modern technology to help people living with limb loss.

item.description: A local community theater group is performing a story of unity after 9/11 with "Come From Away".
